plugins.name: Dropbox
plugins.description: The Dropbox plugin for Cursor connects your Dropbox files directly to Cursor, so you can search, reference, and organize files, save generated content, and create sharing links - all without switching tools. It respects your existing Dropbox permissions, and Cursor only works with files you already have access to.
